expense_employee_party: INSERT INTO finance_parties(id,company_id,kind,code,name,currency,payment_terms_days,person_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(?,?,'employee',?,?,?,0,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(company_id,person_id) WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET name=excluded.name
expense_reversal_journal: INSERT INTO finance_journals(id,company_id,chart_id,period_id,journal_number,entry_date,currency,fx_rate_micros,source_type,source_id,memo,status,created_by,posted_by,posted_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT ?,company_id,chart_id,?,?,?,currency,fx_rate_micros,'expense_reversal',?,?,'posted',?,?,?,?,? FROM finance_journals WHERE id=?
expense_reversal_lines: INSERT INTO finance_journal_lines(id,journal_id,account_id,description,debit_minor,credit_minor,base_debit_minor,base_credit_minor,dimension_json,ordinal) SELECT ?||'-'||ordinal,?,account_id,description,credit_minor,debit_minor,base_credit_minor,base_debit_minor,dimension_json,ordinal FROM finance_journal_lines WHERE journal_id=?
